hard_rules: NEVER SHOW THE ANSWER IN THE STUDENT IMAGE; apply the shared student-figure answer-neutrality contract to every student-facing visual.
Notability/iPad-first student layout with generous response space; wasted space is acceptable.
Captured source figures may be prominent and sometimes lead the explanation.
Do not squeeze images into thumbnail decorations; preserve readable labels/relationships.
Student images must remain answer-neutral for prediction/inference tasks.
Teacher copy releases fixed workspace heights and expands naturally; no overlap.
Production HTML uses the Base-approved CSS order; do not invent a third stylesheet solely for patch rules.
source_image_rule: Copy selected Framework source images into the deployed Notes section figures/assets folder so Notes remain portable; do not hotlink Framework paths.
